name: session-weather
description: A pane with the session's weather: context fill and auto-compact point, the last turn, the 5-hour and weekly limits and this session's part of each, the cost, and a Haiku summary of what Claude is thinking; wide, the limits' pace, what fills the context, the subagents at work and the recent turns; a status line while it is hidden

summaryLanguage.title: Thinking summary language
summaryLanguage.description: The language Haiku writes the thinking summary in, named as you would to a person: English, Vietnamese, Japanese… The pane's own labels stay in English, but for Vietnamese.

summaryGapSeconds.title: Seconds between summary requests
summaryGapSeconds.description: At most one Haiku request this often while a turn runs, from 5 to 120; a value outside that is held to it. Notes left without an update for three times this long get one.

compactSoonPercent.title: Compact soon at (% of the way to compaction)
compactSoonPercent.description: Where the forecast turns to Compact soon and a toast warns, in percent of the way to the auto-compact point, from 76 to 100; a value outside that is held to it, so Storm (from 75) keeps its band.

cleanupDays.title: Delete the mod's old files after (days)
cleanupDays.description: The thinking logs, debug logs, spend files and saved turns the mod writes under ~/.claude/session-weather are deleted once none has been written for this many days, looked for once a day; 0 keeps them all. From 0 to 3650; a value outside that is held to it.

recentTurns.title: Recent turns kept
recentTurns.description: How many of your latest turns the wide pane lists, and a persisted session's file keeps, the oldest let go past it. From 1 to 30; a value outside that is held to it.
